senses.gloss: f.(b. h.;גלם; ד format., v. Fürst H. Dict. s. v.) like a shapeless, lifeless lump, whence (cmp. דמם) lonely, melancholy.
units: Sot. 42ᵃ in the sea-towns קורין לנידה ג׳ they call the menstruous woman galmudah; R. Hash. 26ᵃ.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 26a:18">Ib.</cite> (phonetic etymol.) <he>גמולה</he> (<cite ref="D00003"><he>דא</he></cite>) <he>מבעלה</he> she is weaned (separated) from her husband; [Ar. ed. Pes. a. Ven. <he>גלומה</he>, which version, however, disagrees with the reference to <cite ref="Genesis 21:8">Gen. XXI, 8</cite> in Ar. s. v.].

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:12">Gen.
